verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that https://vercel.com/openapi.json returns HTTP 200 and contains a valid OpenAPI document, and the Gateway's models endpoint is documented as returning a JSON list of models/pricing programmatically, satisfying the ask for a machine-readable API spec. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the openapi.json specifically scopes to AI Gateway endpoints (vs. general Vercel platform API) and independent/community corroboration of using this spec.
